annotations.title: Create a CV from a role preset

description: Create a new CV pre-filled for a common hands-on job — driver, warehouse worker, healthcare assistant, cleaner, retail or food service — about 70% complete, ready to personalise. Free, no AI. Use when the user needs a CV for one of these roles and has little to start from.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: create_takemeup_cv_from_role
